title: Dead or Murdered? Predicting Responsibility Perception in Femicide News Reports

bias_targets.methodology: Collecting human perception ratings via a large-scale survey on Italian femicide news reports to quantify perceived responsibility, cause, and blame attributed to male perpetrators and female victims, and training regression models (including fine-tuned BERT architectures) to automatically predict these bias and victim-blaming scores based on linguistic features (e.g., semantic frames, syntactic constructions).
